name: Hunan Corun New Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Corun New Energy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the energy storage, and lithium and nickel batteries sectors in China and internationally. The company offers battery material, porcelain stone mines, and battery-grade lithium carbonate; consumer lithium batteries comprising shared charging cabinets, sweeper batteries, electric two-wheeler lithium batteries, and electric scooter lithium batteries; and generation and grid side, commercial and industrial, and behind-the-meter energy storage products.
